rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for a cloth used to cover a table.

example.english: Remember to put a tablecloth on before we eat, or the table will get dirty easily.
example.traditional: 食飯之前記得鋪張檯布，唔係好容易整污糟張枱。
